description: This Java class defines character set constants, mappings between character set names and numeric identifiers, and utility methods for charset lookup within an Android MMS library implementation.

classes.name: CharacterSets
classes.description: Utility class providing constants, mappings, and methods related to character set encoding used in MMS messages.

methods.name: getMimeName
methods.description: Returns the charset name associated with a given MIBEnum number; throws UnsupportedEncodingException if not found.

methods.name: getMibEnumValue
methods.description: Returns the MIBEnum number for a given charset name; throws UnsupportedEncodingException if the name is unsupported.
